A dev agent editing status: proposed -> accepted in the diff bypasses that gate — it is a pure data edit of a load-bearing state field with no evidence the human acceptance act occurred. The underlying follow-ups (SPEC-080 approval, founder sign-off per the Status text) are explicitly not yet satisfied.

_Independent fresh-context reviewers (`scripts/review-branch.sh`, no-tools agents reading the diff as untrusted data); each label decided by the deterministic fail-closed gate (`scripts/review-decide.sh`). Posted by `minspec-sdd[bot]` from CI — provenance is the App identity, verified here, not the label alone (#428, #342). Coverage `panel` — voters that ran: **reviewer + architect + skeptic**. Did NOT run: **security** — docs-only change: every changed file is Markdown, so there is no code surface to review. The combined verdict fails toward `changes` if ANY voter requests changes._

commits.messageBody:
Brings the DR-099 acceptance branch up to date with main so the pull request is not behind. No file in the pull request's own diff is changed by this merge.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

The acceptance commit a541ed2d flipped status: and DR-099's INDEX row, and
the Accept path swapped the first word of the Status section from Proposed
to Accepted. The rest of that paragraph still said the record was born that
way and that no acceptance was claimed, so the record contradicted itself,
and nothing in it showed that a person had accepted it.

Reword the sentences the acceptance made false, and add the evidence for
the act, split into what the working tree can confirm (what the Accept path
writes, cited by file and line) and what are git and GitHub facts to
spot-check (commit, author and committer, branch, pusher, pull request).

No status: value, date, INDEX row or Decision text is changed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
